glosses: Personne travestie, quel que soit son genre.

examples.text: Timoléon ne mentionne pas les katoï, les travestis qui se produisaient dans des épisodes du Ramakien, version siamoise du Râmâyana.
Avais-je couché avec le travesti latino ? M’avait-il/elle sucé la queue pendant que j’étais dans le coaltar ? En étais-je réellement arrivé là : capable de n’importe quoi, totalement irrécupérable ?

glosses: Travestissement, déguisement, costume.

examples.text: Il avait mis un travesti pour aller à ce bal.

Je l’avais trouvée charmante dans son demi-travesti, un soir qu’elle jouait Miss Sacripant ; j’étais avec des camarades de club, nous avions tous ramené une femme, et bien que je n’eusse envie que de dormir, les mauvaises langues avaient prétendu, car c’est affreux ce que le monde est méchant, que j’avais couché avec Odette. Seulement, elle en avait profité pour venir m'embêter, et j’avais cru m’en débarrasser en la présentant à Swann.

Il était visible que ce travesti équivoque, plus que tout autre chose, aiguisait l’atmosphère tendue, et que la foule s’y complaisait malsainement, comme on trouve un charme frileux, et peut-être le sentiment d’une présence à soi plus trouble, aux premiers frissons d’une fièvre légère.

glosses: A person who sometimes wears clothes traditionally worn by and associated with the opposite sex; typically a male who cross-dresses occasionally by habit or personal choice.

examples.text: Even though Steven used to dress up in his sister's clothes, it still came as a surprise he ended up as a transvestite.

glosses: A person, typically a heterosexual male, who compulsively seeks and derives paraphilic sexual arousal from cross-dressing, especially if the urges and behavior cause the patient distress or social impairment.
An animal that engages in sexual mimicry.

examples.text: "Proper" scorpion fly behavior entails the catching of an edible insect by the male, who then offers it to the female […] If she likes the gift, she mates with the male. Thornhill, however, has observed males approaching other males, assuming the female role until they get a grip on the food. Once they have it, they try to run away with it. The "transvestite" males, according to Thornhill, have an advantage over the other males because they have others do the hunting for them, leaving the "transvestites" more time to reproduce. In additon ^([sic]), the "transvestite" scorpion flies would avoid such hazards of the hunt as spider webs.

glosses: A person who wears clothing which society considers appropriate only for members of the opposite sex.

examples.text: Tedd: "Between seeing me, knowing my name, and hearing two guys arguing about skirts, he's going to be able to figure out that it was me who answered the door! He's going to know I was transformed!"

For the buildings John uses plastic sheeting employed in the window banners of a particular ladies' clothing chain. [...] I asked John if the sales assistants in those shops thought he was odd, walking in and asking for bits of plastic. 'What you've got to remember,' he said, 'is that they get a lot of cross-dressers going in there, so I'm not that weird in comparison.'
